dataList.content:
... So how are there two Golden Boughs here? I mean, it's a rich family manor, but it's not like they're a corporation or a Syndicate.
……为什么，既不是公司又不是帮派的宅邸里会有两根金枝？
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Hall
呼啸山庄 大厅

dataList.content:
Mm... One was acquired by Linton, who spent nearly all of his fortune on it, and...
嗯……据说其中一根是林顿先生花费几乎全部财产强行弄到手的……

I wonder how he got his hands on the second one?
但他是怎么得到另一根的呢？

It is possible that there may have been an involvement of a third party that helped Linton and Catherine.
推测为存在帮助林顿与凯瑟琳的第三方势力。

With what information we gathered from this Aseah... all evidence seems to point to Director Hermann of N Corp. being our 'third party'.
如果亚细亚所言属实的话……那肯定就是N公司的赫尔曼董事了吧。

Right... hiring former Ring researchers of all people? That's not something you see every day.
确实……从能招募到与环指有关的人来看……他们的规模相当庞大。

So you have all been traveling with Heathcliff, collecting the Golden Boughs... Yes?
你们……一直都在收集金枝对吗？希斯克利夫也一起？

... Yes.
……是的。

Then you must have had to fight so many people in your journey.
那么你们一定不得不和很多人战斗了对吧。

Hm. I suppose every day's been like a battlefield. We've all seen more than enough of our share of battles.
嗯，该说我们的日常就像在战场一样吧。经历过的战斗数都数不过来了。

Can't say I disagree with that comparison. Except we have tasted nothing but victory so far.
不得不说这是个恰当的比喻。除了我们一直获得胜利这一点。

I see.
是这样啊。

So... why are you looking for the Golden Boughs?
所以……你们为什么要寻找金枝？

Boredom.
打发时间。

Well... maybe it'll lead us to loads of money?
嗯……大概是将来能让我们赚大钱？

Aha! Because that! Is an act of justice!
此乃！正义之举！

It's all just a part of our contracts. I don't know what they're planning to do with the Golden Boughs, though.
因为我们签了那样的合同。至于到底要拿金枝做什么我也不知道。

So none of you even know why you are collecting the Golden Boughs.
结果，你们中没一个人知道为什么必须要收集金枝。

... Aren't you scared, Heathcliff?
……你不会害怕吗，希斯克利夫？

Doing everything the company asks you to do, without asking a single question...
不知道缘由就服从公司的指示……

Do you ever worry about... what comes next...?
那之后……会有什么在等待着你……

Nelly. I've always had a singular goal.
耐莉，我自始至终就只有一个目标。

We all do. Because Clockhead keeps reminding us of our individual goals.
我们全都有。多亏了这个钟表头，每当快要忘记的时候他都会让我们回想起各自的目标，无论多少次。

So... no. I've never been afraid.
所以……是啊。我从来没有害怕过。

I could hear the faint sound of horse hooves echoing from above us.
我听到了上方隐隐约约但清晰可闻的马蹄声。

And now, I have but one goal.
现在我的目标只有一个。

We have to go after that git. We can't let him take Catherine to the rooftops where the Golden Bough is.
必须要追上那家伙。我们不能让他带着凯瑟琳去金枝所在的屋顶。

But...
但是……

Isn't it too late now...? We are slow, yet he is swift.
会不会已经太迟了……？我们这么慢，那家伙那么快。

... Vergilius bought us this opportunity.
……维吉里乌斯好不容易为我们争取到的机会。

He must have had to sacrifice something of his to get here. He made that decision for our sake.
为了做出帮助我们的决定，维吉里乌斯肯定也不得不放弃了自己所拥有的某些东西。

I will not waste this chance.
我要抓住这个机会……不能让它化为泡影。

This is the only way to the rooftops, right?
去屋顶的路就只有这一条吗？

Yes.
是的。

Agh... that bastard keeps sending those dregs after us...
唔……那混蛋一直派杂兵过来……

What we need...
我们需要的东西只有一个。

... isn't the strength to defeat them.
不是打倒他们的力量……

What we need is a little time.
而是一点点时间。

<Faust. I'm asking this out of pure curiosity, but...>
<浮士德，我提出这个问题只是出于好奇心……>

Do ask.
请说。

<There's gotta be a good reason my head is, of all things, in the shape of...>
<我的脑袋……本可以变成各种各样的形态，但为什么偏偏变成了钟表的样子……>

<... a clock, right?>
<这肯定有什么理由对吧？>

It can be said that its shape was not determined randomly and without intent.
至少，可以说这个形态并不是毫无意义、随机生成的。

As every shape is followed by concepts and symbols adherent to the laws of causality.
因为所有的形态，都是伴随因果而生的表象与象征。

<And the Golden Bough has powers that I am yet to be aware of.>
<而且金枝仍然有我所不了解的未知的力量吧。>

You are not asking a question. You are asking for a confirmation.
看来你不是在问问题，而是在确认答案。

If that is the case...
既然那样就只需……

Simply do as you will, as one seeks the stars in the night sky.
如同在夜空中探寻星星那样，随意而行即可。

If I can... I mean, my clock or the Golden Bough... or whichever it is... can turn back time...
我……不，我的钟表……不，金枝……不管它是什么……如果有能让时间倒流的能力的话……

... then what's there to say that I can't accelerate it or shorten it?
那难道不应该也能缩短或加快时间吗？

Besides, I...
而且我希望希斯克利夫……

... I did not want my Heathcliff to be tied down to his past like the Heathcliff from the other world was.
不要像那个来自别的世界的希斯克利夫一样……沉溺于过去。

Woah...! Do you feel that?
诶？你感觉到了吗？

We're... faster. Fast enough to outrun our enemies.
我们的速度……变快了。足以摆脱敌人并向上爬。

This is not temporal acceleration, to be precise. It would be more accurate to say we are in a temporal deceleration field that slows everything except us within a certain radius.
准确地说，时间并没有被加快，而是更接近在某个区域内让除了我们之外的一切都变慢了的这种说法。

Whatever it is, we'll catch up to him in no time!
不管怎么样，这样下去我们马上就能追上他了不是吗？

Oi, Clockhead. ... Is this your doing?
钟表头。这是……你做的吗？

<I... think so.>
<大概……是的。>

The Sinners could've complained that 'this would've been very helpful a while ago!'... but I had nothing to say to them.
罪人们并没有向我回以“有这种能力就早点使出来啊！”这种抱怨的话。

Even I didn't know that I had access to such power. I just began to feel the possibility out of nowhere.
连我自己也不知道我能使用这种能力，只是突然感觉到了那种可能性。

Everyone I've gone through in my life...
至今为止，我所经历的大多数关系都是……

Either ignored me, scorned me, or I simply lost the plot before we even had the chance to build anything. It was always a mess.
要么无视我，要么鄙视我，要么是我忍受不了，先一步发火……因为这样，总是一团糟。

But you, Clockhead...
但是钟表头，你……

What is wrong with you...? Why do you still hold any hope for me?
你……到底是怎么回事？为什么你还没放弃我？

You needn't go this far for my sake. The company won't give two shites about any of this. The other Sinners won't, either. So why are you... why are you trying so hard?
适当地应付我一下就好……那样公司也不会对你有什么怨言。你真的有必要……为我如此费心吗？

I don't deserve any of it. I ain't worth—
我不是值得你做到这种地步的家伙，我只不过是……

<Because...>
<要说我为什么……>

dataList.title:
A Distant World
另一个世界

dataList.content:
Heathcliff, focus! He's getting away!
希斯克利夫！不能让他跑了！

Bollocks...
妈的……

Let's crack on for now.
不管怎么说先追上去吧。
